### WebIDE v0.4.1

- 重做了 ACP Agent 面板：支持 OpenCode、Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI 等 ACP Agent，从连接、会话到工具调用形成完整闭环

- 新增本地会话持久化与搜索，支持重命名、置顶、导出；会话管理增加跨项目的「全局会话」

- 新增 token / 上下文占用统计、分级工具权限（只读 / 询问 / 自动放行 / 全部放行）、权限规则记忆与审计

- 新增工具调用卡片、diff 查看、计划 / 任务清单、MCP 服务器管理和技能管理（替代原「记忆与行为」）

- 模型、供应商、思考等级和模式切换改为面板内弹层，不再使用 BottomSheet，也不会再抢输入法焦点

- 重做对话呈现：用户气泡、Agent 卡片、思考与工具折叠行、复制与长按菜单、回到底部按钮

- 重做面板外观：双层头部、Windows 风格窗口按钮、红绿状态点、ACP 官方 logo 头像与可拖拽 chip FAB、共享元素展开动画、3 秒自动吸附

- 输入区改为单行 + 全屏输入，修复输入法弹跳和遮挡；修复 `/init`、`/review` 等斜杠命令被注入前缀导致失效

- 完成中英文本地化：设置、任务清单、会话管理、技能、MCP、全屏输入等弹层都跟随应用语言

- Agent 设置改为三个页签，诊断信息支持复制和保存到 `.webide/logs/`；新增断开连接；登录不再显示假的「已登录」

- Codex 连接问题定位为认证缺失：支持通过 `CODEX_API_KEY` 环境变量连接，不再静默自动认证卡住会话创建

- 修复 AI 助手开关未开启时面板仍默认打开、权限入口不跳对应页签、模型名被截断等问题

- 更新版本号到 0.4.1

# en

- Rebuilt the ACP Agent panel with a complete workflow for ACP agents such as OpenCode, Codex, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.

- Added local session persistence and search, with rename, pin, export, plus an all-projects "All sessions" view.

- Added token / context usage stats, graded tool permissions (read-only / ask / auto-approve / allow everything), remembered rules, and audit records.

- Added tool call cards, diff viewer, plan / task list, MCP server management, and skills management (replacing Memory & Behavior).

- Model, provider, thinking level, and mode switching now use in-panel popups instead of bottom sheets, without stealing IME focus.

- Redesigned chat rendering: user bubbles, agent cards, collapsible thinking/tool rows, copy and long-press menus, and a scroll-to-bottom button.

- Redesigned the panel shell: two-tier header, Windows-style window buttons, red/green status dot, official ACP logo avatar and draggable chip FAB, shared-element expansion, and 3-second edge snapping.

- Composer is now single-line with a fullscreen input dialog; fixed IME bouncing/covering and slash commands such as `/init` and `/review` being broken by injected prefixes.

- Completed Chinese/English localization for settings, tasks, session management, skills, MCP, fullscreen input, and other sheets.

- Agent settings now use three tabs; diagnostics can be copied or saved to `.webide/logs/`; added Disconnect; no more fake "signed in" state.

- Diagnosed Codex connection failures as missing authentication; `CODEX_API_KEY` is supported and silent auto-auth no longer blocks session creation.

- Fixed the AI panel opening by default while the AI switch was off, the permission entry not jumping to its tab, and truncated model names.

- Bumped version to 0.4.1.


**Full Changelog**: `https://github.com/h465855hgg/WebIDE/compare/0.4.0...0.4.1`
